title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila fears staying home alone, while Chozhan buys her gold bangles. Meanwhile, Vannathi questions Pandian to confirm whether he spotted her at the theatre.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Mathi provokes Lakshmi to assign chores to Selvi and ensures she completes them. Later, everyone wishes Mathi well as she starts her new job at college, except Ragavan.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 57: New Leader, New Nominations
description: Lakshmipriya takes the leader’s crown, but luxury shopping brings complaints. Jason is confronted after nominations with chocolates, while the ranking task sets off fierce debates.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: After his release, Sethupathi thanks Tamizhselvi for supporting him and proving his innocence. He apologises to Karuppu for misjudging him, and they share an emotional moment.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun warns Shyam for coming in his way, panicking Madhu. Aadhavan sneaks into Pooja's room, triggering a lizard scare while Pooja insists Aadhavan stay only after marriage.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Kanmani's Big Break at the Expo
description: Anbu massages Kanmani during the pregnancy workshop, easing her discomfort. Elsewhere, Kanmani is thrilled to be selected to present her business idea at an expo.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Shanmugam and Abhi finally get married with Kandhasamy's consent following an emotional moment. Abhi's parents later break ties with her over the secret wedding.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel's insult angers Pandian's family, leaving them furious with him. Meanwhile, preparations secretly begin for Pandian and Gomathi's wedding anniversary celebration.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini urges Meena to rest at Chandra's house. The doctor advises Shruthi against abortion, leading to a clash with Ravi as Meena and Rohini also persuade her to keep the baby.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna and Divakar discuss his release, while Shanmugam makes Abinaya eat the sweet Vetri brought. Vetri shows concern for Abinaya and panics when Sandhya regains consciousness.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Sarasu puts up Muthaiyah's death anniversary posters outside his rivals' homes. Meanwhile, Mayandi wakes Azhagar early and assigns Gomathi and Chelladurai to train him in farming.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma warns Siddharth over bribing voters with drinks. Later, Ilamathi shares Paraman's campaign promises with village women while fearing defeat, Kalamma tricks Paraman.
